notablePrerequisites:
Burrning Anger in hand.Thornbite Staff attached to Dread Slaver.
A player controls a nontoken creature with toughness less than or equal to Dread Slaver's power.
description:
Cast Burning Anger by paying {4}{R}, targeting Dread Slaver.
Activate Dread Slaver by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any creature with toughness less than or equal to Dread Slaver's power.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Dread Slaver triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Dread Slaver.
Resolve the second trigger, returning the creature to the battlefield from its owner's graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
